# The Taskgraph import repair keeps the earlier whitespace fix

The follow-up replaces the attempted comm_taskcluster import with gecko_taskgraph.util.attributes after the reported ModuleNotFoundError. It leaves the preceding integration-lambda whitespace fix intact, so it is a narrow import repair rather than a complete backout. The accepted comparison later uses mozilla_taskgraph with a branch-map argument. These source phases and the reported failure are separate from a freshly executed Python import or generated graph.

Scope: Taskgraph historical import repair.
